caption: The drawing features a central square garden design bordered by brown and beige, with the garden’s layout depicted in green outlines and various sections filled with yellow, pink, red, blue, and white hues representing flowers or plants arranged geometrically. The garden itself is viewed from above, with four green-encased yellow sections at the corners, four green-encased pink sections at the cardinal points, and smaller green-bordered red and oval segments around the design. Each enclosure features differently colored dots and textures, indicating flowers or plants. Surrounding the central plan, the image is bordered by illustrations of large, detailed flowers including yellow lilies and a big red poppy at the bottom right, purple flowers at the bottom left, and various light pink blooms up the left margin. A wrought-iron bench sits at the bottom left, next to mixed foliage and flowers, and a round silver clock lies near the large red poppy at the lower right. At the upper right corner, an archway or greenhouse entrance covered with flowering vines is depicted in perspective, and a bird on a branch is positioned above it. The upper left edge shows a section of leaves and climbing flowers. A faint, labeled garden map or planting diagram is placed at the very top center, partially over the border. Handwritten text at the bottom reads: "Flower-garden from estate of George Lewis Blackwell's Survey."
title: Flower Garden - Lewis Estate
